caption:
Manchester's tap water is naturally soft 💧
Most North West water comes from upland reservoirs, and United Utilities says those are soft or very soft. Water turns hard when it runs through limestone or chalk. Some boreholes in the south of the region are reasonably hard, but they're blended with softer sources. And many bottled waters? Moderately hard.
